purpose: Generate the 206-record general equipment list payload from frozen Stage 2 semantics plus Stage 3-2 display metadata, without reopening classification or inventing missing Korean names/release dates.

recordPolicy.nameKr: Copy only Stage 3-2 verified nameKr. REVIEW candidates must never leak into the page list; null remains explicit and nameCn stays available as source display text.
recordPolicy.icon: Must copy Stage 3-2 VERIFIED_DIRECT icon and be non-empty for all 206 records.
recordPolicy.effect: Copy Stage 2 effectName/effectText verbatim. No translation, summary, or rewrite.

sortingPolicy.tab1: No fabricated historical order. After classification order, use sortIndex asc then equipmentId asc as deterministic fallback only.
sortingPolicy.tab2: Within each group/subtype, sort known releaseGroupDate descending, then sortIndex asc and equipmentId asc. Do not invent order inside a release group.
sortingPolicy.tab3: Current frozen Stage 2 output has no explicit releaseGroupDate for the 32 current-additional records. Keep release-order status REVIEW and use sortIndex/equipmentId only as deterministic fallback, never as claimed release chronology.
never: raw Label numeric order as display order

filterPolicy.selection: A group may be selected alone to show all subtypes. Subtypes are single-select within the active group; list data itself carries one canonical group/subtype per record.

hardRequirements: all Stage 3-1 list fields populated except nameKr/releaseGroupDate where upstream explicitly permits null
sorting comparator follows frozen page policy
reviewAllowed: tab3 exact release chronology absent from frozen Stage 2 source
